entries.composition: Deep buried hall, warm ceiling break, one adult and a visibly split slab opening a route. Strong image-level cause and result.
entries.continuity: Face, beard, teal armor and single gauntlet remain, but anatomical laterality appears reversed: gauntlet extends from the screen-right/near LEFT shoulder in this front three-quarter pose; bare bracing arm originates at the screen-left RIGHT shoulder. entries.cause_effect: Punch and newly opened passage read, though fist is slightly before the fracture edge inside glow.
entries.provisional_repair: Preserve composition and face; place gauntlet on traceable anatomical RIGHT arm with bare LEFT guarding, maintaining actual slab contact.

entries.composition: One full Riven with planted landing boot, falling beam and nearby seam; close evasive pose differs from S01 wide leap.
entries.continuity: Face, hair, clothing and single saber recognizable; added second shoulder armor is minor.

entries.provisional_repair: Keep one hand around actual hilt; make free hand empty and safely apart from blade, preserving planted foot and falling-beam avoidance.

entries.composition: Senn and bowed hound readable, two-handed continuous lance and planted boots. Low view instead of planned high oblique; far outer paw is near right crop.
entries.continuity: Sources recognizable; broad spearhead remains over the shoulder area.
entries.cause_effect: Hound lowered head/body and cyan ground pressure convey suppression. The spear reads broadside over shoulder instead of a precise tip plant; pressure source somewhat ambiguous, but weight effect is legible.
